categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Cai Qin Technology Co., Ltd primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end advanced electronic ceramic components. Its main products include filters, resonators, antennas, and supplementary products such as low intermodulation passive components, metal-ceramic structures, functional devices, RF modules, and systems. These products serve sectors like mobile communications, radar, RF circuits, satellite communications, aerospace, defense, new energy, semiconductors, and the Internet of Things.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary microwave dielectric ceramic material formulations and manufacturing processes, including advanced microwave dielectric ceramic powder preparation, high-performance dielectric waveguide filter technology, large-size dielectric filter manufacturing and assembly, complex ceramic one-time forming, blind hole ceramic metallization and silver brazing, TEM dielectric filter technology, high-performance dielectric resonator technology, dielectric antenna and antenna assembly technology, and low intermodulation passive component technology. Production covers the entire chain from ceramic powder preparation to finished components, enabling flexible multi-variety production tailored to customer needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major communication equipment manufacturers such as Huawei, Qualcomm, Nokia, Ericsson, and China Information and Communication Technology Group, as well as aerospace and defense entities like China Electronics Technology Group and Aviation Industry Corporation of China. The products are widely used in mobile communication base stations (4G, 5G, 5G-A), radar, satellite navigation, aerospace, defense, new energy, semiconductor, and IoT applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant sales in regions including North China, East China, Southwest China, South China, and other domestic areas. It also has overseas sales, serving global communication equipment manufacturers. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Zhangjiagang Free Trade Zone, Jiangsu Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cai Qin Technology operates upstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of core electronic ceramic components and RF devices used by downstream communication equipment manufacturers and system integrators. It controls the full production process from raw material preparation to finished components, positioning itself as a key upstream supplier in the communication and electronic components industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous innovation in electronic ceramic materials and components, emphasizing R&D in microwave dielectric ceramics, HTCC (High Temperature Co-fired Ceramic) technology, large-size dielectric filters, and low intermodulation passive components. It aims to expand product applications into new fields such as new energy, semiconductors, and IoT. The company plans to build a first-class electronic ceramic materials R&D platform, consolidate its industry position in communication base station ceramic RF components, and broaden applications in automotive, consumer electronics, and other IoT markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized electronic ceramic components and modules to communication equipment manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with sales framework agreements and order-based production. It also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies related to its business.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cai Qin Technology is a leading domestic supplier of microwave dielectric ceramic components, especially dielectric waveguide filters for 5G base stations, competing with companies like Wuhan Fanggu, Dongshan Precision, Chunxing Precision, and international firms such as Kyocera and Trans-Tech. It holds a strong market position with recognized technological advantages and scale in the upstream RF component segment of the communication industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 370 million, a 7.16% increase over 2022, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 46.7 million, down 40.55% due to reduced government subsidies and investment income. Total assets reached RMB 2.35 billion, with net assets of RMB 2.14 billion. The company maintains steady revenue growth supported by increased R&D investment (10.55% of revenue) and expanding production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary ceramic powder formulations and advanced manufacturing processes that deliver high Q-factor, low insertion loss, excellent temperature stability, miniaturization, and cost-effectiveness in its dielectric waveguide filters and other components. Its products are recognized for superior electrical performance, reliability, and scalability, meeting stringent requirements of 5G and aerospace applications. The integrated in-house production capability and close collaboration with leading communication equipment manufacturers provide a competitive edge in customization and quality control.
